scope: Seven non-MSA/MERC interaction/fusion papers; mechanism-level Local/Base/Gap readout adaptations, never full-paper reproductions.

shared_adaptation_contract.tokens: At each valid utterance, project existing current Local L, Base B, and three masked Gap vectors G_a,G_t,G_v to a common width. Mask inactive Gap with torch.where before and after biased projection; exclude inactive positions from pooling/attention. No cross-utterance attention.
shared_adaptation_contract.boundary: Reuse existing single Local/Memory trajectory. No new Memory scan, Memory query, cache, auxiliary loss, frozen module, or separate task head. Query projections inside a finite readout token operator are not another Memory query.
shared_adaptation_contract.output: Produce one readout contribution compatible with existing output dimension, normalization and task head. Any common zero-initialized output projection / residual wrapper is an experimental adaptation, not a claimed paper component.
shared_adaptation_contract.screening: One seed is a screening comparison only; fix width/depth before running, retain all results and parameter/runtime costs.

duplicate_warnings: Do not count AFF and iAFF separately: same paper and family.
AutoInt and embedded-Gaussian Non-local reduce to closely related softmax dot-product attention. Use the paper's non-softmax dot-product Non-local variant for a substantively different candidate.
DLRM dot interactions overlap FM/PNN inner-product candidates. If other lanes select those, count this overlap explicitly or replace a duplicate.
CIN is the interaction component of xDeepFM; do not count xDeepFM and CIN as two papers.
DCNv2 full-rank and low-rank variants count as one method/paper.

papers.title: DCN V2: Improved Deep & Cross Network and Practical Lessons for Web-scale Learning to Rank Systems
papers.code_provenance: Official TensorFlow/Google implementation explicitly cites DCNv2 Eqs.1-2; individual paper-author ownership of this file was not established.
papers.formula: x_(l+1)=x_l+x_0⊙(W_l x_l+b_l); low-rank option W_l=U_l V_l^T.
papers.adaptation: Flatten five projected tokens into x0; use a fixed small cross stack and output projection. Preserve all token slots and explicit availability.
limitations: Mechanism adaptation omits CTR embedding tables and original deep/cross prediction architecture.
Full-rank crossing grows quadratically with concatenated width; low-rank is from the same paper, not another candidate.
Code supports extra diagonal scale and preactivation; set these to paper-compatible defaults.
papers.verification: Original method HTML and actual official framework file inspected; author-personal-repository attribution remains unverified.

papers.title: xDeepFM: Combining Explicit and Implicit Feature Interactions for Recommender Systems
papers.code_provenance: Paper links this author repository; README identifies it as paper code.
papers.license: No LICENSE file found in inspected repository tree; no redistribution permission inferred.
papers.adaptation: Use five same-width tokens as fields; compute fixed-depth vector-wise products, compress feature maps, sum channels and project concatenated layer summaries to the readout.
limitations: CIN-only adaptation is not complete xDeepFM: original combines linear, CIN and DNN outputs.
Biased projections must be remasked; multiplicative features are sensitive to scale.
Independently implement equations; do not copy unlicensed source.
papers.verification: Original PDF method and author CIN code inspected; missing code license recorded.

papers.title: AutoInt: Automatic Feature Interaction Learning via Self-Attentive Neural Networks
papers.code_provenance: Author Chence Shi repository; README points to successor DeepGraphLearning/RecommenderSystems/featureRec.
papers.formula: α_ij^h=softmax_j((W_Q^h e_i)^T W_K^h e_j); e'_i=ReLU(concat_h Σ_j α_ij^h W_V^h e_j+W_R e_i).
papers.adaptation: Apply a fixed multi-head interacting stack only across current five tokens; mask inactive keys and query outputs, then flatten/project valid token outputs.
limitations: Readout projections Q/K do not read Memory again.
Author code uses ReLU Q/K/V projections and scaling; paper equations use linear embeddings and unscaled scores. Record selected variant.
Do not call this a full Transformer; no FFN is required by this interacting block.
Avoid counting embedded-Gaussian Non-local as another equivalent implementation.
papers.verification: Original method PDF, author code and MIT license metadata inspected.

papers.title: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
papers.authors_note: Names and order transcribed from inspected arXiv PDF first page; proceedings metadata may differ in ordering/spelling.
papers.method_location: Section 4.3 Eq.3; page4 explicitly removes softmax normalization
papers.code_provenance: First-author repository; README recommends updated mouna99/dien implementation and warns about earlier BatchNorm errors.
papers.license: No LICENSE file found in inspected repository tree; no redistribution permission inferred.
papers.formula: v(L)=Σ_j a(e_j,L)e_j with unnormalized learned activation a; author implementation scores concat(L,e_j,L-e_j,L⊙e_j) through MLP.
papers.adaptation: Condition readout activation on current Local; weight already-read Base and active Gap tokens; concatenate Local and pooled context for one output projection.
limitations: Local activation is over already available contexts, not a new Memory query.
Paper has unnormalized weights; inspected demo applies softmax. Prefer paper equation and document departure from demo.
No behavior sequence, mini-batch-aware embedding regularizer, or extra DIN task loss is transferred.
Independently implement formula; author demo is deprecated and unlicensed.
papers.verification: Original PDF method, exact author demo function and README warnings inspected; code-paper mismatch explicitly retained.

papers.title: Deep Learning Recommendation Model for Personalization and Recommendation Systems
papers.code_provenance: Facebook Research release linked to original paper.
papers.adaptation: Treat projected Local as dense path and projected Base/Gap as additional fields; concatenate Local with ten distinct pairwise dot products, then project to original readout width.
limitations: Retains only second-order scalar similarities; channel-level signed detail can be lost.
No categorical embeddings, distributed embedding system or original sigmoid task head is reproduced.
Closely overlaps FM/inner-product PNN; avoid duplicate counting across the 20 candidates.
papers.verification: Original architecture PDF and official interact_features file inspected.

papers.title: Attentional Feature Fusion
papers.method_location: Section 4.1 Eq.4; MS-CAM combines local and global channel context
papers.code_provenance: Paper-linked author repository; original MXNet implementation inspected, not contributor PyTorch port.
papers.license: No LICENSE file found in inspected repository tree; no redistribution permission inferred.
papers.adaptation: Implemented pooled adaptation: X is projected Local; Y is the active mean of Base/Gap. The local bottleneck sees X+Y; the global bottleneck sees the active mean of all five typed tokens. Their summed logits produce a channel sigmoid, followed by the paper's convex blend. This deliberately removes spatial maps; it is not the full MS-CAM spatial operator.
limitations: Token-space interpretation of spatial MS-CAM is an explicit adaptation.
Pooling across conversation time would change causality and is excluded.
Original BatchNorm requires padding-aware valid-token statistics; replacing with LN is another documented adaptation.
Author ASKCFuse output has factor2 relative to paper Eq.4; freeze the chosen convention.
AFF/iAFF count once; independently implement due missing license.
papers.verification: Original PDF Eq.4 and author MXNet fusion class inspected; code-paper scaling difference recorded.

papers.title: Non-local Neural Networks
papers.method_location: Section 3.2 dot-product Eq.4 and Section 3.3 residual Eq.6
papers.domain: Vision / video classification and image recognition
papers.code_provenance: Official author/Facebook repository linked in paper.
papers.adaptation: Use non-softmax signed dot-product variant on current five-token set; N is active-token count. Mask key/value/query outputs, preserve residual, then flatten/project.
limitations: No spatiotemporal neighborhood or new Memory read is introduced.
Choose this signed 1/N operator to avoid duplicating AutoInt softmax attention.
Original code is Caffe2 and noncommercial licensed; independent paper-based implementation avoids vendoring incompatible source.
Zero-initialized residual output is compatible with the paper, but enclosing Flat residual adapter remains project-specific.
papers.verification: Original PDF exact variant and official non-softmax code branch plus full LICENSE inspected.
